messages.subject: Placement Drive: Windham Freight - Logistics Analyst
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Windham Freight - Logistics Analyst (CTC 8 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT, ME | CGPA 6.5 and above | No active backlogs.

messages.subject: Re: Placement Drive: Windham Freight - Logistics Analyst
messages.body: Update from Windham Freight: the CGPA requirement has been raised to 8.5 and above with immediate effect, due to a higher-than-expected number of applicants. Apologies for the inconvenience.
